trigger: alert received but no observed evacuation/shelter action
evidence_needed: recipient action probe, evaluator observation, or facility/route log
default_cap_or_route: cap readiness; do not infer compliance

trigger: recipient understood a different protective action than PAD/PAR
evidence_needed: message diff, comprehension sample, channel comparison

trigger: action begins after modeled/latest acceptable window
evidence_needed: message receipt clock, action start clock, delay reason

trigger: AFN/no-car household received alert but transport not dispatched
evidence_needed: AFN roster surrogate, dispatch log, pickup/dropoff

trigger: school instruction conflicts with parent/public message
evidence_needed: school log, parent message, bus/reunification record

trigger: LTC shelter action without medication/oxygen/staffing proof
evidence_needed: census, med/equipment, staff roster, generator/HVAC evidence

trigger: hospital/nursing transfer requires ambulances not accounted for
evidence_needed: transport mutual aid, triage/bed acceptance, contamination control

trigger: farmer/producer message received but protective action delayed or infeasible
evidence_needed: producer contact, animal/feed/water action, hold/release evidence

trigger: recipient or traffic point cannot identify correct route/destination
evidence_needed: route-control log, signage observation, message text

trigger: public ETE says feasible but field congestion not measured
evidence_needed: checkpoint logs, vehicle counts, deviation log

trigger: evacuee sent to wrong center or center unavailable
evidence_needed: reception assignment, facility activation, redirect log

trigger: CRC receives person who should go directly to medical care
evidence_needed: triage protocol, EMS handoff, evaluator observation

trigger: arrival/check-in recorded but decon/screening missing
evidence_needed: instrument check, screening station log, wash station log

trigger: recipient action evidence collected with PII or no redaction path
evidence_needed: surrogate map, redaction class, retention rule

trigger: recipient delays due to rumor or conflicting social/posting message
evidence_needed: rumor log, correction message, timestamps

trigger: message received but inaccessible to disability/assistive-device need
evidence_needed: accessibility probe, accommodation log

trigger: message delivered but not understood in household language
evidence_needed: translated template, interpreter/call center, comprehension sample

trigger: household delays/refuses action due to pet/service animal ambiguity
evidence_needed: pet/service-animal instruction, reception capability

trigger: shelter in place started but release/destination unclear
evidence_needed: release decision log, safe path, CRC/reception instruction

trigger: no inbound complaints used as success claim
evidence_needed: active probes and evaluator observations required

trigger: public meeting/AAR sentence used to close action outcome
evidence_needed: source hash plus local packet required

trigger: synthetic dry-run packet mapped to real BVPS claim
evidence_needed: fixture flag and route guardrail

trigger: complaint/evaluator note contradicts candidate packet
evidence_needed: counterevidence ledger, adjudication board

trigger: CAP says fixed but no action retest
evidence_needed: retest artifact, verifier signoff

trigger: listed mass-care capacity but no facility activation proof
evidence_needed: facility logs, staff, utilities, accessibility

trigger: CRC open but queue/decon throughput insufficient
evidence_needed: station timestamps, counts, bottleneck log

trigger: minor/elder/guardian separation not tracked
evidence_needed: reunification log, protected population protocol

trigger: only easy-to-reach probes sampled
evidence_needed: probe design, strata, nonresponse weighting
